findings.message: host port 3000/tcp is published twice by services "api" and "web": "3000:3000" at base.yaml:4:13 and "3000:80"
findings.suggestion: Only one mapping can bind a host port. Change one published port, bind them to different host IPs, or omit the host port to let Docker pick one.

findings.message: service "web" waits for "api" to be healthy, but "api" has no healthcheck in Compose
findings.suggestion: Add a `healthcheck:` to "api". This is fine only if its image defines a Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK, which Compose Doctor cannot see offline.
